Written for Grok Imagine: `grok-imagine-image-2.0` for stills and edits, `grok-imagine-video-1.5` for video. Limits and model names were checked on 2026-09-18 against the sources at the end. Check them again before a batch, they move.

Every prompt below is complete: the house style is already joined on. Paste it as is. The rules in README.md apply to every one of them.

## Stills, from text

Aspect ratio and resolution are set in the interface or the API (`aspect_ratio`, `resolution`), not in the prompt. Ask for 4 at a time and pick one.

### S01 · `art-aisle`

Aspect 16:9 · resolution 2k · for /platform/deployment, /solutions/enterprise-datacenter

```text
A long datacenter aisle between two rows of black server racks, seen from a low centre position, racks receding to a single vanishing point. Hundreds of small status LEDs, mostly emerald with a few cyan and rare amber. A thin cyan light strip runs down the centre of the polished concrete floor. Cool haze near the ceiling, perforated rack doors, overhead cable trays. Dark architectural photography of enterprise compute infrastructure. Near-black blue-grey ground, matte surfaces, a shallow haze, one motivated light source per frame. Accent light only in lavender, cyan, emerald and amber gold, used sparingly as thin lines, status LEDs and rim light. 35mm lens, low angle, deep perspective, fine film grain, restrained contrast, wide dynamic range. All hardware is generic and unbranded. No people, no text, no logos, no readable screens.
```

Keep it if: Symmetric, the vanishing point just above centre, floor reflections visible, no glare that reads as white.

Alt text: A dark datacenter aisle with rows of racks receding to a vanishing point, status lights in green and cyan.

## Video, from text

For a picture we have no still of. There is no source image to hold the look, so the house style is joined onto the prompt in words, and the prompt is longer than an image to video prompt is allowed to be. Expect to throw more of these away. Up to 15 seconds at 720p.

### T01 · `broll-mesh`

Aspect 16:9 · 10 seconds

```text
Thin lines of cyan light travel between three distant clusters of server racks standing apart in a dark void, each line arriving as a soft pulse that briefly brightens the cluster it reaches. Camera slowly orbits to the right. Near-black blue-grey ground, matte surfaces, a shallow haze. Accent light only in lavender, cyan, emerald and amber gold, as thin lines, status lights and rim light. 35mm lens, fine film grain, restrained contrast. All hardware is generic and unbranded. No people, no text, no logos, no readable screens. One continuous motion, one camera path, no cuts. Quiet room tone, no music.
```

Keep it if: Three sites and the links between them, nothing else. It is the picture of an encrypted mesh, so the lines must read as deliberate connections and never as a web or a net.

Alt text: Lines of light travelling between three separate clusters of server racks.

## Never

- The Avarok logo or wordmark. The lockup is vector artwork and is composited in an editor, never generated.
- Product UI. Every screen on the site is a recording of the product mockup. A generated dashboard is a fabricated product claim.
- Readable text of any kind, numbers included. Text is set in the editor in IBM Plex.
- Vendor logos, product designs that identify a vendor, military insignia, flags, government seals, real buildings.
- People with visible faces. Hands and silhouettes are acceptable when a shot needs scale.
- Anything that implies a named customer: a bank's signage, a hospital's name, an agency's badge.
